title: His first drum set, a Wallace outfit
summary: Foster tells of his first drum set, a 26-inch bass drum from Wallace that took six months to reach Mandeville, cost about $110 and came with four cowbells.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Early drum kits and the gear drummers used

blocks.x: He was playing with Buddy, and he was playing with Buddy, and he was playing with Buddy. And I told Buddy I was playing, I had my drums, and he was surprised. I made him on a big Sunday night. I mean, a big Monday night we played at Cheshire Club, and it was Rowley. I was playing with him. He was the same old man that didn't go to the John Rubin Show. They were surprised to see, because John Rubin Show knew when I came here. He was the same old man that didn't go to the John Rubin Show. You remember him? Go ahead.
I never knew, I heard of him a lot.
That's when I had told him I had got my drums, you know. And I started out playing. Well, I played with embers. And they were embers, the embers, and he died. Right there on the yellows' feet.
What kind of a drum set did you have when you started out? How big a set was it, and what kind of drums?
I had one of those big old yellow 26 inch bass drums.
Remember what make it was?

Wallachs. Wallachs. Rudolph Wallachs. I set the cistern out and got it. Well, it's a realtor. It was. Yeah, and that drum was exactly six months getting here. See, that drum was six months getting... Yeah? Yeah. Well, getting to Mandeville. Wow. That's right. And I got that drum in there, but it got lost. Went all around, and I had to write back to em, you know, and they'd write back to me, and they'd trace it. And it'd take exactly six months for that drum to come. I had never had my hand on a drum seat before. Would you believe it or not? That's not true.
You didn't have any hand on a drum seat before. Can you imagine?

It started right out as a good set then. Yeah, it started right out with the Wallachs drums. That's right. You must have been kind of nervous. Oh, yeah. Oh, yeah. How old people can tell you about it? That's right.
What kind of a snare drum was it? It was the whole set of drums. The whole set.
The whole set. The whole set, huh? Because it was a different time, it cost me around $110 at the time. Yeah. That's right. What did you say? Come right on in.
Let me follow you. Let's do it. Hold on. Let's do it.
Wallachs drums, as you know, they're... I don't know about now, but they're... at those times, they had good products. They were really good. They're really good.
It's a good company. They've gone into jukeboxes now and electric organs mostly.
Yeah, that's what they go for now. But sometimes, yeah.
What did the set consist of? How many drums and cymbals and so on?
Naratantant. Two drums. Tamarine. What, tamarine? Yeah, tamarine. That's right, tamarine.
Tamarine, a bass drum and a snare drum.
Bass drum, snare drum and a drum stand. How many cymbals? Any cymbals? Yeah, and one cymbals. That's right. All the cowbells and the cymbals. No. They had cowbells with it. Yeah.
Them kind of drum just come with some trays on top of it. Huh? Did they have any wood blocks with it?

No. I think I got the wood block here. When I got here. There was the four wood blocks on top. I got the blocks here. I think I did. I'm not sure. Yeah, I had the blocks, but I got the blocks. That didn't come with the set. I got the blocks here. We used to use them every time they would block. They were right sure. That's right. You used them four cowbells. Four cowbells. Now the cowbells came with the drums. That's what came with the drums. The cowbells, yeah. Was it a set of four cowbells?

Four, yeah. It was a set of four. Yes. They had four. The next size, the next size, the next size. That's right. We always had called him Alexis. I couldn't find him. Who is that? Alexis, Rickard's brother. You know. You used to call Rickard, Rickard. The other one, Kingston, by his name. But when he was taught by the drum, he always said Alexis.
Yes, he still don't know his first name. He said Alexis, yeah.
He was on the election, yeah.
